content.text:
Scout is a specialized reconnaissance tool designed to analyze URLs for security threats, tracking parameters, and obfuscation techniques without exposing the user to malicious payloads.

It combines [bold green]Static Heuristics[/], [bold cyan]Network Intelligence[/], and [bold red]Threat Reputation Feeds[/] to provide a comprehensive risk assessment.

items.text:
[bold cyan]--reputation[/]
[dim]Enable API checks (VT, URLhaus, etc). Requires API keys.[/]

[bold cyan]--offline[/]
[dim]Perform static analysis only. No network requests.[/]

[bold cyan]--json[/]
[dim]Output raw JSON to stdout (for piping).[/]

[bold cyan]--stdin[/]
[dim]Read URLs from standard input (pipe mode).[/]

content.text: Scout calculates a Risk Score (0-100+) based on 4 layers:

items.text:
1. [bold]Network Chain[/]
- Unshortening URLs
- Detecting Meta Refresh
- Circular Redirects
- Protocol Downgrades

2. [bold]Static Syntax[/]
- Direct IP Usage
- Embedded Creds (@)
- Suspicious TLDs
- Executable Extensions

3. [bold]Advanced Modules[/]
- Homoglyph/Spoofing
- High Entropy (DGA)
- DNS Age & MX Records

4. [bold]Reputation[/]
- VirusTotal
- Google Safe Browsing
- URLhaus
- PhishTank

content.text: To use [bold]--reputation[/], configure your keys in [italic]sniper-config.json[/] or use configer:

[dim]$[/] configer set tools scout api_keys virustotal [green]"YOUR_KEY"[/]
[dim]$[/] configer set tools scout api_keys google_safe_browsing [green]"YOUR_KEY"[/]

[dim]# Basic Scan (Unshorten & Heuristics)[/]
[bold]scout https://bit.ly/suspicious[/]

[dim]# Full Scan with Threat Intel & HTML Report[/]
[bold]scout https://fake-bank.com --reputation -o report.html[/]

[dim]# Pipe from Social-Dive to Scout[/]
[bold]social-dive "target" --json | scout --stdin[/]
